summary: Iteration 10 testing of new security authz (talent dashboard + shortlist), login brute-force lockout, pools/admin regression, AI crawlability endpoints, legal pages and cookie consent. Backend: 33/33 pytest assertions pass (new file /app/backend/tests/test_iteration10_security_crawl.py). Frontend: all legal pages, footer legal links, footer navigation and the full cookie-consent flow (accept/decline/persist/reopen) pass AFTER a frontend restart — the dev server was serving a STALE bundle that omitted the new PublicLayout footer links. Two real gaps found: homepage (Landing.jsx) footer has no legal links / cookie-preferences button, and CORS is allow_credentials=True with allow_origins='*'.

minor.issue: Brute-force counter has no sliding window / reset: db.login_attempts.count only ever increments (never reset by elapsed time). After a 15-min lock expires, count is still >=5, so the NEXT single wrong password immediately re-locks for 15 min. Reset count when last_attempt is older than the window.

allow_credentials=True combined with allow_origins from CORS_ORIGINS='*' (backend/.env). Wildcard + credentials is rejected by browsers for cookie auth and is a security smell; set explicit origins per the auth playbook.

Playbook item 'httpOnly cookie set on login' NOT implemented — login returns only a body token (no Set-Cookie: access_token). _current_user does read an access_token cookie, so the cookie path is dead code. Design choice, but flag: token stored client-side (localStorage) is XSS-exposed.
No _require_employer on list_pools (POST/candidates are guarded). A talent token gets 200 with an empty list instead of 403 — inconsistent with the stated policy.
All links inside llms.txt are site-relative (/careers, /jobs...). Absolute https URLs are recommended for LLM crawlers. Not a failure.

ui_bugs.issue: Homepage footer contains NO Privacy / Terms / Cookies / Data Request links and no 'Cookie preferences' button (Landing does not use PublicLayout). Legal/consent links are unreachable from the most-crawled page — compliance + crawlability gap.

design_issues.screen: Any page with cookie banner open
issues: Fixed bottom-right banner (z-60) overlaps the footer legal row: 'Cookie preferences' and 'Build your profile' are partially covered at 1920x1080, so the reopen button sits under the banner it opens. Consider adding bottom padding to footer while banner is open.

action_items: Add legal footer links (Privacy/Terms/Cookies/Data Request) + Cookie preferences button to Landing.jsx footer, or reuse PublicLayout footer on the homepage.
Reset login_attempts.count when last_attempt is outside the window so an expired lock does not re-lock on the first subsequent failure.
Optionally add _require_employer to GET /api/pools for consistency (currently 200 + empty list for talent).

NOTE (env): the CRA dev server did not hot-reload PublicLayout.jsx/StaticPage.jsx edits (bundle lacked footer-privacy-link until 'supervisorctl restart frontend'). Restart frontend after frontend edits before self-verifying.
